critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 738 lines - close to the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into routers/auth/crud/import modules.

normalize() uses a fragile list-comprehension to locate the dataset key: `DATASETS[[k for k,v in DATASETS.items() if v['module']==module][0]]`. Prefer building a MODULE_TO_DATASET dict once at import.
meta/options queries distinct() across all 5 collections on every call - fine now but consider caching for scale.

import_preview builds `columns` using a chained expression that only evaluates when `rows` is truthy but the ternary is at the end (`... if rows else []`), which technically works but is confusing; also duplicate-key handling is fine since dict preserves order.
seed_admin only resets password on mismatch; does not sync role/name if drifted. Not blocking for now.
No brute-force lockout on /auth/login (playbook mentions 5-fail lockout) - not explicitly requested in this iteration's spec.
CORSMiddleware allow_credentials=True with FRONTEND_URL is correct; cookie httponly+secure+samesite=none is set (works over https preview).
